name: Overhear
summary:
Subtitles for everything. Play a video in any app and read what it says. Or point it at the room and read the people around you.

  - Understand any language. Captions in English, French, German, Spanish and Japanese, with instant translation between them.
  - Know who said what. Each speaker gets their own colour and name.
  - Never miss a sound. An alarm, a baby crying, a word you care about: the panel flashes to catch your eye.
  - Keep what mattered. Save a talk, a meeting or a video as a transcript or
